Date: 2025-08-09 09:12 -0700
Subject: GCP Marketplace listing: kickoff + procurement lane questions

Hi Vivek / Laura,

Thanks again for the GCP listing walkthrough last week. Procurement at AcmeCloud wants to lock down the internal approval path before we start the formal onboarding. A few asks from our side so we can map the right owners on our end: 

- Can you provide a simple roles/approval map (who signs/approves technical vs commercial vs security) and an estimate for lead time for PO vs invoice billing?
- Do you have a standard PO flow for GCP Marketplace (commit terms, billing entity, tax treatment)?
- Any attachments we should expect (SLA, SOC2 evidence, data processing addendum)?

If you can send a one-page owner map and the procurement checklist, we can route internally and come back with a single consolidated list. Looking to get approvals by mid-August.

Cheers,
Sanjay Rao
Director, Cloud Procurement | AcmeCloud
procurement@acmecloud.com

Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace listing: kickoff + procurement lane questions

Thanks Sanjay — great to hear procurement is lining this up. I pulled together a lightweight roles & approvals matrix (attached) that separates Technical, Commercial, and Security signoffs and shows typical SLA/PO handoff timing. High level: 

- Technical approvals: usually Product/Platform (we suggest Naomi as primary), review window 3-5 business days.
- Security/compliance: SOC2 + DPA review (if you need packaged artifacts we can share our SOC2 summary and redacted controls), typical review 5-10 business days.
- Commercial/PO: Sales + Finance (PO vs invoice depends on your billing entity and whether you want Marketplace metering or a committed SKUs contract).

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll kick off a 30-min sync with procurement and Naomi to confirm the security artifacts needed.
2) Laura will share the procurement checklist & sample PO path.
3) We’ll update the owner map and return a single consolidated doc for your routing.

Can we schedule the sync Tues 8/12 at 10am PT? If that works I’ll send calendar invites.

Best,
Vivek Kulkarni
Head of GTM Partnerships | Redwood Inference
vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0132

Hi Sanjay — looping in Naomi (security/compliance) and Karthik (billing/ops) so we have the right SMEs on the thread. A couple practical notes from our side: 

- Attachment: procurement_checklist.pdf (stub) — this lists typical docs we provide (SLA, SOC2 summary, DPA, network diagrams for private deployments).
- For marketplace metered billing, invoices are generated by Google and paid to Google; if you want direct invoicing from Redwood we need a commercial contract (we can support monthly/quarterly invoicing under a reseller flow).
- Lead times: if you need a committed SKU (reserved capacity) that adds ~2 weeks of commercial negotiation; SOC2/DPA exchanges typically resolve within 1-2 weeks if you use our standard DPA.

Next steps: Vivek will set the sync for Tues. Karthik — can you confirm whether Redwood can support AcmeCloud’s PO template (attached) or if we need our legal team to review changes?

Thanks,
Laura Bennett

Hi Sanjay — quick answers and next steps from billing/ops side: 

1) Direct invoicing: Yes — Redwood supports direct invoicing under a commercial contract (we can set net-30). For committed SKUs we typically execute a short order form + SOW and then invoice monthly. For pure metered Marketplace listings you default to Google billing.
2) SLAs: Marketplace listings can include a service-level summary, but enterprise SLA commitments (credits, uptime SLA) require a direct contract. We can provide a Marketplace-facing summary for your legal team and add enterprise SLA language in a commercial agreement if you need credits.
3) PO template: looked it over — the majority of fields are standard. One item to flag: the liability cap language (section 6) is broader than our standard; if you could highlight the exact alternative language you need we’ll route to legal ASAP.

I’ve created a shared folder with the artifacts and added a HubSpot note (HS-2319). Vivek will send the invite for Tues 8/12 10am PT. Attached below is the Drive link and my quick internal owner list: 

- Commercial owner: Laura Bennett (sales ops)
- Security owner: Naomi Feldman (security/compliance)
- Billing/ops owner: Karthik Iyer (platform billing)
- Contract lead: Legal (will engage if PO language deviates)

Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDef-Shared-Onboarding
HubSpot: HS-2319

Look forward to the sync.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Platform Billing Lead | Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
